title: ACTOR: Action-Centered Temporal Organization for Literary Role-Playing Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.03184v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language agents for literary role-playing are typically modeled around dialogue generation, leaving characters' non-dialogue behaviors and their dynamic evolution over story time underrepresented. In this paper, we propose ACTOR (Action-Centered Temporal Organization for Literary Role-Playing Agents), an automated framework for constructing such behavior trajectories from raw novel texts. ACTOR extracts dialogue and persona-relevant non-dialogue behaviors, represents each behavior using a Thought-Action-Observation structure, and organizes behavior trajectories according to the internal temporal order of the story. We build a behavior dataset from 143 diverse literary works. For each source behavior, we generate counterfactual behaviors that are contextually plausible yet inconsistent with the character's persona. translated_title: ACTOR：以行动为中心的文学角色扮演智能体时序组织框架
translated_abstract: 用于文学角色扮演的大语言智能体通常围绕对话生成进行建模，导致角色的非对话行为及其在故事时间中的动态演变未得到充分体现。本文提出了ACTOR（Action-Centered Temporal Organization for Literary Role-Playing Agents，即面向行动的文学角色扮演智能体时序组织框架），这是一个从原始小说文本中自动构建此类行为轨迹的自动化框架。ACTOR提取对话以及与角色人设相关的非对话行为，使用“思考-行动-观察”（Thought-Action-Observation）结构来表示每个行为，并按照故事内部的时间顺序组织行为轨迹。我们基于143部风格多样的文学作品构建了一个行为数据集。针对每个源行为，我们生成了在上下文中合理、但与角色人设不一致的反事实行为。我们发现，现有模型难以从历史行为中可靠地推断出符合角色一致性的行为及其演变……
tldr: 提出ACTOR自动化框架，从原始小说文本中提取非对话行为、以“思考-行动-观察”结构表示并按故事时间顺序组织成角色行为轨迹数据集，并通过反事实行为实验揭示现有模型难以可靠推断与角色人设一致的行为。
en_tdlr: ACTOR is an automated framework that extracts persona-relevant non-dialogue behaviors from raw novels, represents them with Thought-Action-Observation structures, and organizes them into temporally ordered behavior trajectories, whose counterfactual benchmark reveals that existing models struggle to infer persona-consistent actions.
